elevation.$description: Confirmed via Figma variables (Drop shadow/*) and cross-checked against all 5 apps' Tailwind boxShadow config — already identical everywhere, no ratification conflict. Just needed one shared home. ⚠️ Real-usage audit (2026-07-23): in every single app, developers reach for Tailwind's STOCK shadow classes (shadow-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl) alongside — sometimes more than — this named scale (e.g. one app: 65 stock-class uses vs. 41 named-token uses; another: stock shadow-lg alone outnumbers named shadow-large). A CI lint blocking stock shadow-* classes in favor of these named tokens would close a real, consistently observed gap, not a hypothetical one. Also found: recruitment-portal has a recurring raw box-shadow focus-ring effect (rgba(53,61,215,0.12), a translucent primary-500) used identically across 4 files — a DIFFERENT color scheme than the Figma-confirmed focus-ring below (#E1E1FE); worth reconciling into one focus-ring definition rather than carrying two.

xsmall.$description: Confirmed repeatedly via named 'Drop shadow/XSmall' variables: Input Field/Box (removed entirely in the Disabled state), and Button Group. Real-usage audit: the most consistently-used named shadow token across all 5 apps.

focus-ring.$description: Confirmed twice — Input Field/Box's Focused/Typing states, and again inside Table Content Cell's embedded input. A 4px solid-color ring, not a blurred shadow. Color (#E1E1FE) is close to but not identical to primary-100 (#E0E2FF), a small drift in the same shape as the brand-gold one. Only appears on the Box input style; the Line style changes only its border color on focus, no ring. See this token group's top-level note re: a second, differently-colored focus-ring pattern found in code.

small.$description: Confirmed via the Stat component's named 'Drop shadow/Small' variable.

medium.$description: Real-usage audit: weak-to-moderate — near-zero in most apps but a healthy 85 uses in dashboard specifically. Not dead, just unevenly adopted.

large.$description: Confirmed via the Tooltip component's named 'Drop shadow/Large' variable.

xlarge.$description: Confirmed twice — once via a named Figma variable, again via live design context on the Modal component (both Horizontal and Vertical alignment).

xxlarge.$description: Real-usage audit: dead as a named class in every one of the 5 apps checked — the least-evidenced token in this file. Kept for scale completeness; confirm it's still wanted before Phase 3.
